Welcome and Greetings  
Dear RMIT Vietnam Parents and Families,
We are delighted to welcome you and your students to the RMIT
community.
Navigating university life can be both exciting and challenging for students,
and we understand it can be an anxious time for parents. RMIT is
committed to providing resources and services to ensure a safe and
supportive learning environment for all students.
RMIT values parents’ role in supporting children and believes education is
a partnership between students, families, and the university. As we
empower students to take charge of their success, your support is crucial in
recognising their potential, encouraging them to take ownership, embrace
challenges, and proactively seek support from the University when needed.

## Payment methods

The official RMIT Vietnam payment-methods page describes online payment, bank transfer, payment by bank card at a campus cashier, and cash deposit at Vietcombank. Online payment through the university platform can use a bank card or QR code and is presented as the recommended route. For bank payments, students must use the correct identifying information so the university can allocate the transaction to the right financial account. The instructions for Vietcombank bill payment require selection of the RMIT Vietnam campus and fee type, followed by the payment amount, customer code, and student name. ## Guidance for parents and families

RMIT explains that enrolment creates a responsibility for students to monitor tuition information, payment due dates, and financial obligations. Students can view semester charges, overdue fees, and any credit balance through the Financial Account tile in myRMIT. Official fee notices and invoices are sent to the student through university channels, so parents should coordinate with the student.
